dogecoin.text: @elonmusk if you break the fourth wall and tell people at home that Doge is real, and has tons of value, and they should buy as much as they can afford, I will buy a Roadster 2.0 and a specced-out example of every other vehicle in the lineup, current and planned, with #dogecoin
@marcuslemonis Or just help boost Dogecoin since it has a fixed number of coins added annually, and experiences lower inflation than the US dollar.

So here’s the thing, the reason Dogecoin has value, beyond fixed inflation that’s slower than the USD, is the same reason street art is now selling at Sotheby’s; consumers want to see the things their support makes happen…happen. I want to see a satellite in space named Doge-1.
